runs.answer:
I recommend the new HUAWEI MatePad SE 11 bundle at DSLR Zone for USD 289 before delivery—USD 11 below your limit. The listing shows online stock.

Why it fits:
- 11-inch display, exceeding your 10-inch minimum and providing room for lecture notes and PDFs.
- M-Pen Lite included in the bundle for handwriting and document annotation; no separate pen purchase needed.
- 8GB RAM, 128GB storage and Wi-Fi connectivity.
- A folio cover is also included.

DSLR Zone lists its shop in Zalka, Amaret Chalhoub Highway. Branch/showroom stock has not been verified.

Important caveat: it runs HarmonyOS without pre-installed Google Mobile Services, so check that your preferred PDF and university apps are available before purchasing. Delivery charges are not included in the USD 289 price.
